_comment: Element catalogue. Patterns switch these on and set params; the Elements tab (Phase 3) is built from this file. status: ready = has a generator; planned = coming in a later phase (ignored until then).

slats.label: Wood slats
slats.tip: Rows of thin wood-look blades with gaps. Louver = the same idea with angled or horizontal blades. They shade, add privacy and warmth.

fins.label: Vertical fins
fins.tip: Thin vertical blades (concrete or metal) beside or in front of windows. They cut low morning / evening sun.

jaali.label: Jaali screen
jaali.tip: Jaali = a perforated screen of brick, concrete blocks or laser-cut metal. Lets in breeze and soft light, keeps out harsh sun.

boxFrames.label: Box frames around windows
boxFrames.tip: A projecting frame around a window. It shades the glass, protects from rain and adds depth.

cladding.label: Feature wall cladding
cladding.tip: A layer of wood-look panels, stone, brick tiles, fluted panels or terracotta tiles on a chosen wall. Its look comes from the Feature wall material.

stoneBase.label: Stone base
stoneBase.tip: Cladding on the bottom of the walls and parking columns. Plinth = this bottom band; it takes splashes and scuffs.

canopy.label: Entrance canopy
canopy.tip: A small roof over the entrance door or the pedestrian gate.

sunshades.label: Sunshades over windows
sunshades.tip: A projecting ledge (chajja) above a window. Blocks high sun and rain.

roofOverhang.label: Roof overhang
roofOverhang.tip: The roof slab projects beyond the walls, shading the top floor and keeping rain off the walls.

pergola.label: Terrace pergola
pergola.tip: An open frame of beams on the terrace for dappled shade.

parapet.label: Parapet and roof edge
parapet.tip: Parapet = the low wall around the terrace. Thin edge, thick band, or glass.

railings.label: Balcony railings
railings.tip: The balcony edge: frameless glass, vertical bars, a solid wall, or a curved wall with glass (as on your current design).

roundedCorners.label: Rounded corners and arches
roundedCorners.tip: Soft rounded edges and arch-shaped frames, added as a surface detail only (no structural change).

planters.label: Planters
planters.tip: Built-in plant boxes on balcony and roof edges.

lighting.label: Facade lighting
lighting.tip: Uplights, wall washers, linear LEDs and bollards. Shown in night mode (Phase 4).

mainDoor.label: Main door style
mainDoor.tip: The entrance door: wood, pivot, or a colour accent.

compoundWall.label: Compound wall and gate
compoundWall.tip: The boundary wall around the plot and the gates.

landscaping.label: Landscaping
landscaping.tip: Lawn, gravel, pavers, driveway, trees and plants. Ground and paving materials already follow the palette.

solar.label: Solar panels
solar.tip: Rooftop solar panels on a frame over the terrace.

nameSign.label: Name sign
nameSign.tip: The building name on the road-facing wall.
